Job Title: Cloud-Native Security & AI Architect (GCP / Zero Trust) Location: Hybrid Dearborn, MI or Fully Remote (US based) Team: Ford Credit Enterprise Architecture

About the Role: Ford Credit is accelerating its transition to a Zero-Trust security model on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and maturing their enterprise cloud security patterns. They are seeking a Cloud-Native Security & AI Architect to guide on-prem workload migrations into a secure, well-architected GCP environment, while also shaping their approach to safe and effective AI enablement (with a focus on agentic patterns in the SDLC). This role will help establish practical reference architectures, answering various How do I do X securely questions from internal teams, driving clarity where standards are still emerging.

What Success Looks Like (6 12 Months):

  • Documented, adopted reference architectures and patterns for Zero Trust on GCP.
  • Reduced critical security gaps across migrated workloads; measurable maturity lift (e.g., from 1/5 toward 3/5).
  • Repeatable Apigee patterns established; known gaps documented with remediation backlog and owners.
  • Teams self-serve with How to do X securely guides; faster decision cycles and fewer escalations.
  • Safe, pragmatic AI enablement patterns integrated into SDLC with clear guardrails and logging.
  • Established security governance frameworks and stage-gates with both automation and human-in-the-loop processes.

Tools & Ecosystem: GCP (IAM, Workload Identity, VPC, SCC, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Logging/Monitoring, GKE/Cloud Run, Build/Artifact), Apigee, GitHub, JIRA, Confluence, Vault (as applicable), Terraform (nice to have).

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of IT experience with 7+ years in cloud architecture/engineering with 4+ years focused on cloud security (enterprise scale).
  • Deep hands-on experience with GCP services relevant to security: IAM & Workload Identity, VPC/SCC/Cloud Armor, Secrets Manager, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, GKE/Cloud Run, Artifact/Build, Pub/Sub, Apigee.
  • Proven experience designing or maturing Zero-Trust architectures (BeyondCorp principles; identity-centric access).
  • Strong understanding of OAuth/OIDC, service-to-service auth, token flows, and API security patterns.
  • Experience designing security for hybrid architectures that connect modern cloud platforms with traditional enterprise data centers through GCP Interconnect, including mainframe systems.
  • Experience with SaaS security frameworks and tools, such as Cloud Access Security Brokers (CASB), SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), and advanced data loss prevention (DLP) strategies.
  • Integrate security seamlessly into the CI/CD pipeline (DevSecOps), ensuring automated guardrails and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scanning are part of the "golden path."
  • Experience producing reference architectures, standards, and golden paths for engineering teams.
  • Good knowledge of security.
  • Hands-on use of AI tools to improve productivity (e.g., coding, analysis, documentation).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder enablement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • GCP security certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Experience with Apigee at enterprise scale (API gateways, policies, auth patterns, observability).
  • Familiarity with LLM/agent attack vectors (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, data exfiltration) and mitigations aligned to industry frameworks OWASP for LLM, NIST AI RMF etc.
  • Exposure to spec-driven development and content-distributed architectures.
  • Understanding of regulated environment and associated compliance frameworks PCI-DSS, SOC2, CCPA, GDPR and auditable human-in-the loop decisioning.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building standards in-flight during large-scale migrations.

Zero-Trust Cloud Security Architecture (GCP) primary focus

  • Define and mature security architecture patterns and reference architectures for cloud-native workloads on GCP.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance to application teams migrating from legacy environments to a new Zero-Trust GCP segment.
  • Conduct gap analyses and recommend remediations to raise security maturity.
  • Translate Ford s Information Security Policies (ISP) into actionable architecture guidance and guardrails.
  • Establish golden paths for securing RPC endpoints, service-to-service auth, workload identity, runtime security, and logging.
  • Design and document secure patterns for hybrid connectivity, ensuring safe data exchange and identity federation between on-premise data centers (including mainframe environments) and GCP.
  • Develop a holistic security strategy for critical third-party SaaS applications, focusing on identity integration (SSO), data governance, and unified visibility.
  • Partner with threat modeling, networking, and data architecture teams to ensure holistic, risk-balanced designs.

API & Apigee Security Enablement

  • Define patterns for securing APIs and RPC endpoints with Apigee (authN/Z, token flows, rate limiting, telemetry).
  • Identify platform gaps; collaborate with Ford s Apigee owner (EPEO) to drive improvements and reusable examples.

AI Architecture (Agentic SDLC) secondary focus

  • Evaluate AI-enabled solutions for safety and security: Is this secure Is it safe Are we allowed to do this
  • Define secure agent patterns for SDLC use cases (e.g., agents drafting JIRAs, triaging issues).

  • Design human-in-the-loop, decision traceability, and auditable logging for AI-assisted decision flows.

Process & Enablement

  • Mentor teams; answer questions rapidly; help the org balance speed with security in a zero-trust context.

title: SoC Performance Modeling & Architecture Engineer
jobDescription:
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated SoC Performance Modeling & Architecture Engineer to drive the definition, analysis, and optimization of our next-generation Systems-on-Chip (SoCs). In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end performance lifecycle from workload analysis and microarchitectural modeling to post-silicon correlation. You will evaluate complex architectural trade-offs across CPU, GPU, NPU/ML accelerators, Memory, and Network-on-Chip (NoC) subsystems to maximize performance-per-watt and shape the roadmap for future silicon.
Key Responsibilities
1. Performance Modeling & Simulation
  • Leverage and Maintain Cycle-Approximate Models: Leverage, and maintain execution-driven and trace-driven SoC performance simulators (e.g., using C++, SystemC, or Python).
  • Explore Architectural Space: Construct scalable models to project the performance of future SoC configurations and validate architectural concepts before RTL freeze.
  • Hardware/Software Co-Design: Model the interaction between hardware subsystems and low-level software stacks to identify system-wide bottlenecks.
2. Workload Analysis & Benchmarking
  • Characterize Workloads: Profile and analyze industry-standard benchmarks and real-world use cases across CPU (e.g., SPEC CPU), GPU (e.g., 3DMark, GFXBench), and Machine Learning/AI (e.g., MLPerf, LLM inference, CNNs).
  • Trace Generation: Capture and manipulate instruction and memory traces from both pre-silicon environments and post-silicon hardware.
3. Subsystem & Interconnect Analysis
  • NoC & Fabric Optimization: Evaluate Network-on-Chip (NoC) topologies, routing algorithms, arbitration schemes, and bandwidth/latency characteristics under heavy multi-master workloads.
  • Memory Hierarchy Evaluation: Analyze the impact of cache hierarchies (L1/L2/System Cache), memory controllers, and various memory technologies (e.g., LPDDR5/6, HBM) on system performance.
4. PPA (Power, Performance, Area) Trade-off Studies
  • Multi-Domain Trade-offs: Evaluate complex trade-offs when scaling or configuring different combinations of CPU cores, GPU compute units, and ML accelerators.
Required Qualifications & Skills
Technical Expertise
  • Education: BS/MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in SoC/Processor architecture and performance modeling.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in C/ C++ and Python
  • Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of modern computer architecture, including pipelining, out-of-order execution, cache coherence protocols, and virtual memory.
  • Modeling Frameworks: Direct experience with performance modeling frameworks (e.g., gem5, SystemC, or proprietary cycle-accurate / cycle-approximate simulators).
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience with post-silicon debug tools and reading hardware performance counters (e.g., ARM PMU, Intel VTune, or internal test chips).
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and compiling/mapping models to specialized hardware accelerators.
  • Experience utilizing data visualization tools to present complex performance metrics cleanly to cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Senior Test Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description

Job Purpose

The Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (ICE) presents a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and address complex business challenges in the ficial sector. The ICE Senior Test Engineer position plays a key role in testing and delivering trading, listing, compliance and surveillance applications, while supporting all stages of the Software Development Life-Cycle (SDLC). The successful candidate will be able to multitask in a dynamic team-based environment, while demonstrating strong problem-solving, extensive technical skills, decision-making abilities and the highest level of professionalism. The candidate is also expected to have excellent business knowledge/experience.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Test Engineer with expertise in Options Derivatives with FIX Protocol to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Options, Capital Markets and FIX Protocol. This role focuses on ensuring the quality of software applications, particularly related to options trading platforms. This includes designing and executing test scenarios and test cases, identifying and reporting bugs, and collaborating with developers to resolve issues and ensure a high-quality user experience. They also work to improve testing processes and tools.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to cover functional, performance, and usability aspects of the options trading platform.
  • Identify, document, and report software defects using bug tracking systems, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.
  • Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the development and maintece of automated tests to improve testing efficiency and coverage.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements in the test automation lifecycle.
  • Ensure that new features or bug fixes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
  • Be an active participant in planning and designing product features with the ability to view the product from a customer perspective.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams involved in product delivery.
  • Develop, update, maintain and execute automated tests.
  • Review and triage test failures and verify fixes.
  • Maintain clear and concise documentation of test plans, test cases, test results, and bug reports.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, driving bug isolation and helping restore the service.
  • Work with minimum of technical supervision.
  • Stay current with the latest engineering technologies and best practices.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Solid hands-on experience in the Options derivatives domain, including strong knowledge of options trading workflows, order types, and lifecycle management, coupled with proven expertise in FIX protocol messaging for order entry, execution, and drop-copy session handling.
  • Proficient in Linux command-line usage, including log navigation, file management, process monitoring, and scripting for test environment setup and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries for test data validation, result verification, and database state analysis across QA environments.
  • Deep understanding of software testing methodologies and best practices, with the ability to design comprehensive test strategies for complex trading systems.
  • Proven experience across a range of testing techniques including functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing within ficial or trading application environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sharp attention to detail, particularly in identifying edge cases and defects within high-throughput trading systems.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking and project management tools such as Jira, with experience managing full bug lifecycle from identification through resolution verification.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance testing productivity, including automated test case generation, log analysis, root cause investigation of test failures, and intelligent defect triage.

Preferred Knowledge and Experience

  • Experience with other trading and ficial applications is a plus.
  • Good knowledge of FIX protocol is a plus.
  • Experience with supporting production changes, UAT testing and debugging prod issues.
  • Results Driven: Drive, focus and commitment to deliver results that meet the requirements of internal customers along with the passion for quality and getting the right results in the right way. Ability to work tight schedules/deadlines and multitask.

title: B2B Manager Corporate Training
jobDescription:
Role Overview

The B2B Manager - Corporate Training will be responsible for identifying, acquiring, and managing business partnerships across corporates, colleges/universities, and institutions for SkillzRevo Academy's training portfolio. This includes solutions in Data Science, AI, Generative AI, Cyber Security, Cloud, BI, DevOps, Emerging Tech, and Professional Skills Training. The role requires strong industry networking, consultative selling skills, and the ability to present training solutions to decision-makers such as HR Heads, L&D Managers, CHROs, Deans, Principals, and Academic Directors.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Business Development - Corporate Sector: Identify and onboard corporate clients for technical and professional training programs. Establish relationships with HR, L&D, CTO, CIO, and departmental heads. Conduct client meetings, presentations, and capability demonstrations. Understand organizational training needs and propose customized learning solutions. Drive end-to-end corporate sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, proposal, negotiation, closure.
  2. Institutional Sales - Colleges & Universities: Build partnerships with colleges and universities for student career programs, tech skill development, and certification courses. Collaborate with placement cells, training & development departments, and academic leadership. Propose student-centric solutions like bootcamps, certification tracks, workshops, and faculty development programs (FDP).
  3. K-12 School Outreach: Build relationships with schools for AI, coding, robotics, computational thinking, and STEM programs. Collaborate with school principals, academic coordinators, and program heads. Promote SkillzRevo's K-12 learning modules and workshops.
  4. Revenue Growth & Pipeline Management: Achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets. Maintain a healthy sales pipeline across sectors (corporate, higher education, K-12). Prepare proposals, quotations, MoUs, and commercial discussions. Upsell and cross-sell SkillzRevo Academy's training portfolio.
  5. Relationship Management: Maintain strong post-sales relationships for repeat business. Ensure seamless coordination with training operations and delivery teams. Resolve client queries, ensure client satisfaction, and monitor training outcomes.
  6. Market Research & Strategy: Analyze market trends and competitor offerings. Identify new training opportunities, industry gaps, and emerging technology demands. Provide strategic input to product development teams for new programs.

Key Performance Areas (KPA)

  1. New Business Acquisition: Corporate partnerships; College & university tie-ups; School collaborations.
  2. Revenue Generation: Achievement of sales targets; Growth in training revenue from assigned territories.
  3. Client Relationship & Retention: Quality of engagement with key accounts; Repeat business and referrals.
  4. Proposal & Pitch Excellence: Customization quality; Pitch-to-conversion ratio.
  5. Market Expansion: Number of geographies/sectors tapped; Expansion of product reach at the institutional level.

College & University KPIs: New institutional tie-ups per month; Student enrollments generated from campus partnerships; Number of workshops/seminars conducted in colleges.

K-12 KPIs: Number of school partnerships secured per quarter; Workshops/bootcamps delivered in K-12 segment; Revenue generated from school programs.

Relationship & Delivery KPIs: Client satisfaction score (CSAT 4.5+/5); Percentage of repeat business; Timely proposal submission (within 24 hours).

Operational & Reporting KPIs: CRM updates 100% maintained; Weekly and monthly sales reports; Pipeline accuracy and forecasting.

Purpose of the Role

To support Product Owners and Feature Teams in delivering onboarding journey outcomes through data analysis, control monitoring, governance and operational execution.

To be successful as an Acquisition & Onboarding - BA4 Product Owner, you should have:

Basic/ Essential Qualifications:

This role will be based out of Pune

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility making sure the right thing is being built , and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.

  • Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.

  • Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.

  • Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.

  • Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.

  • Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.

  • Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.

  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e. g. , customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.

  • Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and run activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.

  • Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

title: AI Engineer: Agentic Systems & War Simulation
jobDescription:
• A system where AI agents play through ten thousand conflict scenarios overnight, discover strategies that human planners would never consider, and stress-test every plan against an adversary AI that actively tries to break it
  • India enters any conflict having already explored more of the strategic space than any human planning staff ever could
  • The war is fought in simulation a thousand times before it is fought once in reality, and the side that has done that preparation wins
  • This is not a simulation with better graphics
  • It is a tool that out-thinks the adversary
  • What Youd BuildYou own the AI agent architecture
  • Someone else builds the simulation engine
  • You build the intelligence on top
  • Agents that reason about complex multi-day, multi-front operations and explore the strategy space at a scale no human planning staff can
  • Adversarial agents that find the weaknesses in any plan before the enemy does A learning loop where agents get meaningfully smarter over thousands of self-play iterations
  • A reasoning layer that can explain to a military commander why a strategy works and where it breaks, with specific evidenceThe hard problems youd spend your time on:How do you represent the state of a complex, partially observable conflict so an agent can reason about it effectively?How do you combine long-horizon strategic planning with tactical adaptation?How do you build a Red agent that is genuinely dangerous rather than a scripted opponent?How do you make agent reasoning auditable and trustworthy enough that a commander acts on it?Why This Is HardThe action space is enormous
  • The environment is partially observable and stochastic
  • The adversary adapts
  • Planning horizons span days, not moves
  • A single decision (when to commit reserves, which front to prioritize) cascades in ways that only become visible much later
  • Standard approaches break in ways that are obvious once you understand the problem, but non-obvious if youre pattern-matching from existing work
  • No standard playbook exists for this
  • Youd be designing the architecture from first principles
  • Who This Is ForWe dont care about years of experience or seniority
  • We care about how you think
  • The bar is: can you design and build an agentic architecture that outcompetes systems built by teams ten times your size at companies with a hundred times your budget? If yes, the rest doesnt matter
  • What were looking for:Exceptional first-principles thinking
  • You derive architectures from the problem, not from what youve seen others do
  • Deep independence
  • You take an ambiguous, open-ended problem and come back with a working system
  • No hand-holding, no waiting for specs
  • Technical brilliance in at least one of: reinforcement learning, LLM agent architectures, multi-agent systems, game AI
  • You dont need to be broad
  • You need to be devastatingly good at the thing youre good at
  • No defence background required
  • No specific tool or framework required

jobDescription:

  • India enters any conflict having already explored more of the strategic space than any human planning staff ever could

  • The environment is partially observable and stochastic
  • The adversary adapts

  • A single decision (when to commit reserves, which front to prioritize) cascades in ways that only become visible much later
  • Standard approaches break in ways that are obvious once you understand the problem, but non-obvious if youre pattern-matching from existing work
  • No standard playbook exists for this
  • Youd be designing the architecture from first principles
  • Who This Is ForWe dont care about years of experience or seniority

  • What were looking for:Exceptional first-principles thinking
  • You derive architectures from the problem, not from what youve seen others do
  • Deep independence
  • You take an ambiguous, open-ended problem and come back with a working system
  • No hand-holding, no waiting for specs
  • Technical brilliance in at least one of: reinforcement learning, LLM agent architectures, multi-agent systems, game AI
  • You dont need to be broad
  • You need to be devastatingly good at the thing youre good at
  • No defence background required
  • No specific tool or framework required

Qualifications

  • Experience strategizing, designing, architecting, and leading the deployment of scalable solutions on GCP, strongly preferred.
  • Experience with traditional and cloud infrastructure as well as cloud migrations.

jobDescription:

What This Is Not

  • Not incremental bug fixing this is a strategic modernization and re-architecting effort focused on core platform interfaces and machine interoperability.
What You ll Need
  • Typically 10+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in backend systems, distributed architectures, and platform engineering.
  • Demonstrated success architecting, building, and evolving complex APIs and distributed systems at scale.
  • Proven experience modernizing legacy platforms and mission-critical production systems without disrupting business operations.
  • Deep understanding of API contracts, schema design, deterministic behavior, observability, validation, versioning, authentication, authorization, and integration reliability.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to understand platform-wide architectural implications and downstream effects on AI agents and orchestration systems.

And It s Great to Have

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration systems, or building structured interfaces for LLM-powered tools and agents.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, workflow orchestration systems, and high-throughput distributed platforms.

ABC Fitness is building toward an AI-native future where intelligent agents, orchestration systems, and automation platforms can securely and reliably interact with our products and services at scale. title: Manager, Quality Digital Systems
jobDescription:
Use Your Power for Purpose


Every day, our unwavering commitment to quality ensures the delivery of safe and effective products to patients. Our flexible, innovative, and customer-oriented culture is rooted in science and risk-based compliance. Whether you are involved in development, maintenance, compliance, or analysis through research programs, your contribution directly impacts patients.


What You Will Achieve

The Manager, Quality Digital Systems will serve as a subject matter expert for RQA s digital quality systems, with experience in Veeva eQMS configuration and GxP-regulated system operations. This role is accountable for the reliable administration and continuous improvement of Veeva eQMS processes, including access management, business administration, release coordination, and reporting. The successful candidate will bring configuration expertise - understanding vault object relationships, shared versus instance-specific configuration, and the downstream consequences of proposed system changes - enabling faster, better-informed decisions on enhancement requests and system design questions. The successful candidate must understand stakeholder needs, assess business and technical trade-offs, and support technology decisions that advance quality operations and broader business objectives.


Beyond day-to-day operations, this role independently represents the RQA Digital Systems team within cross-functional programs and enterprise initiatives. This includes scoping RQA s responsibilities within a given program and developing and driving the execution plan on behalf of the team. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, maintaining clear situational awareness across assigned responsibilities and bringing issues and decisions forward proactively.


This position requires deep Veeva domain knowledge, strong analytical and organizational skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a regulated pharmaceutical environment, both as a technical advisor and as an accountable owner of complex, cross-functional work.

Responsibilities:

Veeva eQMS Operations Administration

  • Serve as the primary business administrator for Veeva eQMS on behalf of Regulatory Quality Assurance.
  • Manage and resolve system administration tickets requiring business-level intervention; triage and escalate as appropriate.
  • Own access request intake and provisioning across RQA s digital systems environments
  • Support Veeva release coordination through UAT, business approvals and communications, and production deployments.
  • Maintain and continuously improve job aids, quick reference guides, and user-facing documentation for Veeva eQMS and integrated supporting tools, keeping materials current across system releases.
  • Develop, prepare, and deliver reporting across functional areas.

eQMS Systems Expertise Advisory

  • Provide authoritative guidance on Veeva vault configuration options in support of the businesses needs, including object relationships, shared configuration dependencies, and the downstream impact of proposed changes.
  • Support the triage and formulation of eQMS enhancement requests, providing technical context and impact assessment alongside stakeholder needs and operational impacts to inform prioritization and decision-making.
  • Stay current on Veeva platform developments and GxP digital systems best practices, especially with respect to emerging AI technologies, applying that knowledge to improve system design and operational outcomes.
  • Participate in eQMS governance forums, representing RQA Digital Systems interests and staying current on platform developments.

Cross-Functional Program Support

  • Independently represent the RQA Digital Systems team within enterprise programs and initiatives requiring digital systems support, scoping team responsibilities, developing execution plans, and delivering against them.
  • Maintain clear ownership of workstream status and decisions; proactively surface blockers or escalation points to leadership.
  • Coordinate with Pfizer Digital and cross-functional teams to support enterprise quality data integrity and system continuity efforts.

Reporting Data Operations

  • Issue clear and timely communications, ensuring stakeholders are informed and aligned on timelines and expected outcomes
  • Execute periodic data extracts and reporting tasks in support of regulatory and quality operations, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and appropriate documentation.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation and user guidance for current and legacy quality systems to ensure operational continuity.
  • Gather, synthesize, and prepare materials for stakeholder communications and leadership briefings, translating system and data insights into accessible formats.

Transformation Continuous Improvement

  • Proactively identify opportunities for meaningful process improvement and digital transformation within RQA s quality systems operations, bringing both technical grounding and operational context to proposed solutions.
  • Apply practical AI knowledge to evaluate use cases, partner with technical teams, and support adoption of AI-enabled solutions.
  • Contribute to and support broader organizational transformation initiatives, including AI integration into quality workflows, eQMS process redesign, and platform evolution.
  • Stay current on Veeva platform capabilities, GxP digital systems trends, and regulatory expectations, applying emerging best practices to improve the team s operations and delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Bachelor s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Hands-on Veeva Vault eQMS experience, including configuration, administration, and working knowledge of vault object relationships and shared configuration dependencies.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of AI-enabled tools, automation, or advanced analytics, with experience implementing AI to improve processes and increase efficiency.
  • Experience in a GxP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotech environment with demonstrated understanding of quality management system processes.
  • Proven ability to operate autonomously and collaboratively on complex, cross-functional work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to assess the downstream impact of system changes and translate business needs into actionable system decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear documentation, user-facing guidance, and stakeholder-ready reports.
  • Experience with data reporting tools and/or data extraction (e. g. , SQL, Spotfire, Power BI, or equivalent).

Preferred:

  • Experience with Veeva Vault configuration in a pharma or CRO setting, including participation in system releases, eQMS governance forums, or enhancement request management.
  • Familiarity with Pfizer enterprise data and/or source systems.
  • Exposure to data platforms Snowflake, DSS/Dataiku or related data engineering tools.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Automate or similar automation tools.


Work Location Assignment: Remote

title: District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
jobDescription:
Designation- District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
Programme- Strengthening Indias Agricultural Transformation- Rural Growth Hub Pilots
Reporting To- PMU Lead
Engagement Type- Fixed-term Employment
Locations (One Position for Each Location)- Bachhwara, Begusarai (Bihar) | Pallahara, Angul (Odisha) | Maregaon, Yavatmal (Maharashtra) | Indora, Kangra (Himachal Pradesh)

Vision for the Role
Athena Infonomics is supporting the NITI Aayog in the design and implementation of the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) programme- a three-year field engagement demonstrating how integrated, convergence-led agricultural transformation can be achieved at the village cluster level. The programme operates across five states - Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Himachal Pradesh- with one pilot district and one focus block per state.
The RGH is the operational centrepiece of this engagement. It brings together government schemes, frontier technologies, community institutions, and market linkages within a single village cluster as mutually reinforcing components of a coherent local development system. Rather than adding another layer to an already crowded programme landscape, the RGH works through what already exists: mapping farmers to schemes they are eligible for but not accessing, embedding technologies within existing government delivery channels, and strengthening the capacity of frontline officials to coordinate more effectively. The programme sits within a broader national architecture. PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY) provide a reference framework for scheme convergence across 100 aspirational agricultural districts that RGH could learn from and inform. The upcoming Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme (RPRP) is expected to provide a future financing pathway for scaling what the RGH pilots demonstrate.


The District Coordinator is Athenas single point of contact at the district and focus block level across all concerned departments. This is the role of the primary field intelligence anchor - someone sufficiently embedded in the district and block ecosystem to understand what is happening in practice, what are the opportunities for convergence and what needs to be enabled to make it happen, and how the RGH model can credibly strengthen farmer, village, and block-level outcomes. The District Coordinators ground-level judgement and documentation are the raw material from which the programme learns.


What You Will Own
  • Ground-level intelligence: a current, granular understanding of the agricultural and rural livelihoods landscape in your district and focus block - going beyond administrative data to understand what is happening in practice, how frontline officials are operating, and where scheme intent diverges from farmer experience, existing adoption level of technologies and the market for such services.
  • District and block action plan engagement: systematic gathering and analysis of the District Agriculture and Allied Activities Plan (DAAP) and block-level action plans wherever they exist, and contribution to the design of the Village Cluster Agriculture Action Plan (VCAAP) - the shared planning instrument anchoring the RGH cluster.
  • Intervention mapping, validation, and orchestration: a comprehensive, honest assessment of all active interventions in the focus block - government schemes, technology pilots, and civil society activities - evaluating what is working for which farmer profiles and documenting clearly where it is not. The role is primarily to inform the larger orchestration efforts towards matchmaking, prioritisations, additional activities to amplify impact by different stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder interface: Establish and manager primary working relationship with the District Collectors, District and Block Agriculture / Horticulture Officers, BDO, DPM-RL, Village Pradhans, Panchayat Secretaries, CRPs, KVK staff, and NRLM field functionaries - convening cluster coordination meetings and tracking scheme enrolment, delivery timelines, and institutional bottlenecks. The role also requires engagement with officials at the state level on areas where state level institutions, infrastructure and digital initiatives could be leveraged for scale up.
  • Technical and process documentation: weekly field observation logs, structured farmer feedback records, convergence opportunity matrices, technology adoption data, and monthly field intelligence reports - the mechanism through which ground-level learning becomes evidence that shapes programme adaptation and national policy.

Key Responsibilities

Scheme convergence and farmer-level mapping
  • Map every farmer in the RGH cluster to their current scheme enrolment status, eligibility gaps, and access barriers, building a convergence opportunity matrix per farmer profile and season. Build a strong and contextual understanding of focus schemes including underlying issues and challenges, areas for improvement etc.
  • Coordinate with block and district line department officers to unlock scheme access for eligible farmers, with particular attention to women farmers, SHG members, and marginal landholders. Track progress weekly against the programme target of a minimum of five schemes per farmer in the cluster.
Frontier technology assessment and deployment support
  • Assess existing frontier technology deployments in the focus block - drones, AI advisory systems, soil health tools, precision irrigation, digital crop surveys - evaluating adoption rates, farmer experience, and input efficiency outcomes.
  • Support identification and validation of additional technologies to be layered on existing interventions if any, ensuring they are embedded within government delivery systems and that data collection protocols meet programme standards.
Ground intelligence and field reporting
  • Maintain weekly field observation logs and prepare monthly field intelligence reports synthesising what is working, what is not, and what course corrections are needed.
  • Oversee conduction of structured farmer feedback sessions at the midline and endline, contributing to the programmes baseline-midline-endline survey framework and the generation of outcome data on farm income, yield, input costs, and market access.
  • Travel between the District Headquarters and Blocks as needed with a focus on project outputs and outcomes rather than activities.
Data systems and Shared Data Map maintenance
  • Maintain and update the Shared Data Map - the field-level data convergence instrument to ensure clarity on what data systems, parameters exist including information on data quality, validation status etc.
Community institution strengthening
  • Engage with SHG leads and KVK extension staff to assess the institutional capacity of community organisations around collective scheme enrolment, market linkage, and technology adoption and identify areas of support.

Additional Responsibilities

In addition to responsibilities under the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) Project, the selected candidate will be expected to support and contribute to other ongoing projects, assignments, and initiatives undertaken by Athena Infonomics in the state, as and when required. Such responsibilities may include project planning, stakeholder coordination, data collection and analysis, reporting, field implementation support, and any other tasks aligned with the candidates role, skills, and organizational priorities.

Who We Think You Are
You are likely to have between six and ten years of experience working at district /block / state level in agriculture, rural development, livelihoods, or related fields. You may have come through a social enterprise, an NGO, a government programme implementation role, a development consultancy, or a technology-for-development organisation. What matters most is whether you have spent substantive time at the district level collaborating with frontline officials, community institutions, and farmer households - and whether you understand how government actually works in the states where this programme operates.


You are genuinely curious about why things do not work. When a scheme is not reaching farmers, you want to understand the precise point at which it breaks down. You do not accept low awareness as a sufficient explanation. You have the patience to sit with a Block Agriculture Officer or a Panchayat Secretary and understand their actual operating constraints, not their official account of them. You write clearly - field reports that are honest about what did not work, specific about why, and clear about what it implies. You are at ease in a programme designed to learn and adapt rather than to deliver a fixed model.


WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BRING
  • A postgraduate qualification in agriculture, rural development, public policy, economics, social work, or a related discipline is the minimum educational requirement.
  • Between six and ten years of work experience, with at least three years in a district or block-level role in agriculture, rural livelihoods, or a related programme.
  • Direct prior experience of working with state government departments - particularly those relevant to agriculture, rural development, and livelihoods - in the state of the district you are applying for. This is a requirement, not a preference.
  • Demonstrated experience of working across a multi-stakeholder ecosystem comprising government line departments, self-help groups, civil society organisations, and private sector service providers.
  • Working familiarity with at least one government scheme MIS or data system - e.g., the NRLM portal, PM-KISAN, PM KUSUM, PMKSY, PM-DDKY, PMFBY, AgriStack, or equivalent - at an operational level.
  • Strong written communication skills in English and in the native language of the district of posting.
  • Exposure to frontier technologies in agriculture is an advantage, though not a prerequisite.

What Athena Offers
The District Coordinator role sits at the most consequential part of Athenas work - the point at which research, policy, and technology meet the reality of a farmers field. The programme is a national engagement with NITI Aayog, supported by a leading philanthropic organisation, and designed to generate evidence that informs how India approaches agricultural transformation at scale. The field intelligence you produce will feed directly into the formulation and design of the RGH models across the focus blocks.

You will work closely with the central PMU team at NITI Aayog and Athena s Core Project Team, with regular structured feedback and cross-district learning cycles built into the programme design. Athena is investing in building its agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice into a substantive national and international portfolio. For the right candidate, this role offers a genuine pathway into a growing organisation that values people who understand what is happening on the ground.

  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to development sector norms for district-level technical roles.
  • Travel support for district and block-level field visits and quarterly cross-district learning sessions.
  • Access to Athenas central research, data, and technology capabilities, including the APLYD AI and digital public infrastructure unit and the TolaData impact monitoring platform.
  • Structured mentorship from the central PMU team, with opportunities to growth within Athenas agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice. [1]

Application Requirements
Please note that the selected candidates would be stationed at the identified block within the district with frequent travel to the District Headquarter.
  • Updated CV - not exceeding three pages.
  • A covering note (maximum four hundred words) on: which block you are applying for, your most relevant prior experience, and one observation from your field experience that you believe is underappreciated in how agricultural programmes are designed or how frontier technologies could witness accelerated adoption in the country.

title: Senior SDET
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Join the award winning Sophos XGS Firewall team as a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) and help shape the future of network security. Recognized in the 2025 CRN ARC Awards including Product Innovation and Support across both Enterprise and SMB Network Security Sophos XGS is a globally trusted platform used by over 600,000 organizations worldwide. This is an opportunity to work on a high performance firewall platform, redefining secure connectivity through cutting edge automation and scalable test frameworks.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test for the control plane, you will lead the design and development of the software, infrastructure, and processes required to validate our next generation control plane. You will own the end to end test strategy, with a strong focus on APIs, functionality, scale, performance, security, and other non functional areas. The role involves driving early design and API specification reviews, building and evolving test automation, and adopting modern tools to achieve high quality standards.

You will work closely with Development, Quality Engineering, and Support teams, collaborating with engineers across Bangalore, Vancouver, Pittsburgh, and Ahmedabad in a globally distributed, high impact engineering organization.

What you will do

Quality & Test Strategy Ownership

  • Own and drive the end to end test strategy for the firewall control plane, ensuring comprehensive coverage across functionality, APIs, scale, performance, interoperability, and security.
  • Define quality goals, test approaches, and success metrics aligned with shift left quality principles.
  • Ensure strong requirements, code, and solution level coverage throughout the development lifecycle.

Automation & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and enhance test automation frameworks, libraries, and tools using Python based technologies.
  • Lead API, CLI, and system level automation for complex networking solutions.
  • Drive adoption of automation for non functional, performance, and security testing.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Actively participate in design and architecture reviews, representing quality expectations early in the development cycle.
  • Work closely with Development and QE teams on triage, debugging, impact analysis, and fix verification.
  • Partner with Support and field teams to investigate production issues, collect logs, reproduce issues, and validate fixes in lab environments.

Mentorship & Continuous Improvement

  • Mentor and guide junior engineers on complex features, new technologies, and advanced test approaches.
  • Research, evaluate, and introduce new testing tools, techniques, and best practices to continuously improve quality and efficiency.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the Sophos product portfolio, validating end to end customer solutions involving multiple networking products (Firewalls, Switches, Routers).

What you will bring

  • 8-12 years of overall experience, with strong hands on focus on test automation of over 6 years.
  • Solid experience testing networking products such as Firewalls, Switches, Routers, and management software.
  • Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals (L2/L3) and application level protocols.
  • Proven experience in test automation using Python (Robot Framework or similar), with a focus on building reusable libraries.
  • Hands on experience with API testing (REST and gRPC), including authentication mechanisms, using tools like Postman and programmatic approaches.
  • Experience across the full Quality Engineering lifecycle: functional, integration, non functional, performance, and security testing.
  • Strong debugging skills, including log analysis and system level issue investigation.
  • Working knowledge of Linux systems, kernel concepts, and networking stacks.
  • Experience with traffic generators such as BreakingPoint and related automation APIs.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, Nexus).
  • Experience testing both hardware appliances and virtual images.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Exposure to AI assisted tools for test automation, code generation, review, or productivity improvement.

Job Summary
We are seeking a talented Simulation Engineer to join our team, specializing in Digital Twin Simulation and Network Optimization. This role involves designing and implementing simulation models and optimization solutions to enhance warehouse logistics, resource allocation, and network efficiency. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise in Python, simulation modeling, and optimization techniques, along with a passion for solving complex operational challenges.
Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain digital twin simulations for warehouse and logistics systems, modeling system states, events, and resource interactions.
  • Create and optimize network models to improve flow, resource allocation, and operational performance.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate simulation and optimization solutions into existing workflows.
  • Analyze simulation outputs to pinpoint inefficiencies and recommend actionable improvements.
  • Write modular, testable, and efficient code to support simulation and optimization projects.
  • Document processes, methodologies, and findings for technical and non-technical audiences.
Must-Have Technical Skills
  • Core Python : OOP, data structures, algorithms; writing modular, testable, efficient code
  • Data Manipulation & Numerical Computing: pandas for cleaning/analysis; NumPy for computations
  • Data Ingestion: fetching from REST APIs (requests) and databases (SQL)
  • Discrete-Event Simulation: DES principles; SimPy for modeling states, events, resources (e.g. warehouse flows)
  • Operations Research & Optimization: LP/MIP formulation; Python libraries (OR-Tools, Pyomo, PuLP); familiarity with VRP basics and assignment problems
  • Graph Analytics: NetworkX for building/analyzing network topologies and flows
  • DevOps & Version Control: Git with CI/CD pipelines; Docker containerization
  • API Development: building/deploying REST services with Flask or FastAPI
  • Visualization: creating plots and dashboards using Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly
Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Commercial Solvers: Gurobi or CPLEX and their Python APIs
  • ML-Enhanced Simulations: integrating scikit-learn or TensorFlow/PyTorch models for predictive maintenance or anomaly detection in digital twins
  • Alternative Simulation Paradigms: agent-based modeling, etc.

  • 3D Visualization: pyvista or vedo for complex digital-twin renderings

Algorithm, Firmware Software Interface Architecture

tagsAndSkills: sigma,global delivery,six sigma,back office,process design,ai,workflows,change management
jobDescription:
Executive Summary

Blackbaud is seeking a Process Architect to design, standardize, and continuously improve end-to-end delivery processes across Professional Services. This role will strengthen operating models, clarify process flows, and define ownership structures that enable scalable, consistent, and high-quality service delivery across our global workforce. The Process Architect will partner across teams to improve efficiency, reduce complexity, and protect the customer experience as the organization evolves.

Role Summary

The Process Architect is responsible for improving how Professional Services work gets planned, routed, delivered, and supported across teams. This role focuses on simplifying processes, clarifying how work moves through the organization, and helping teams adopt consistent practices that improve efficiency, collaboration, and customer experience.

Operating Model Process Design

  • Define end-to-end service delivery processes across implementation, optimization, and managed services
  • Create standardized workflow playbooks and process maps
  • Establish clear handoffs across teams

Front Office vs Back Office Segmentation

  • Define responsibilities between customer-facing and non-customer-facing roles
  • Eliminate role duplication and ambiguity
  • Partner with leadership to evolve role definitions

Global Workforce Enablement

  • Identify work suitable for different global teams
  • Design transition and ramp plans
  • Partner with Global leadership to ensure readiness and quality

Process Governance Quality

  • Define KPIs including cycle time, quality, and customer impact
  • Establish governance models across global teams
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives

Capacity Flow Optimization

  • Design workflows to balance global workloads
  • Reduce bottlenecks and inefficiencies
  • Define intake and routing processes

Automation AI Enablement

  • Identify repeatable activities and manual handoffs that can be streamlined through automation or AI-supported workflows
  • Partner with operations, enablement, technology, PMO, RMO, and delivery leaders to pilot scalable automation opportunities
  • Translate process insights into practical AI use cases that improve quality, speed, consistency, and consultant experience
  • Ensure automation supports customer experience, delivery quality, and responsible adoption practices

Change Management Adoption

  • Partner with the PMO to drive adoption of new processes
  • Partner with enablement for training
  • Act as liaison between strategy and execution
